svg.title: SBMS code history
svg.desc: Mainline source-code changes, 2026-06-27 to 2026-11-19. Each commit adds green upward candles then red downward candles. Linear cumulative net lines; equal spacing per commit. Excludes vendor code, non-code files, this chart generator and chart-only commits. Snapshot bd9fc250579aa03062b4c7ef4b58acb3eb6a67e7.
